$comment: ACM type:style -> the wp-ja-vega pattern that renders it, field by field, for the seeder (skills/tracy-wordpress-theme/scripts/seed.mjs renderAcm, `${type}:${style}`). Field names are the Joomla ACM field names VERBATIM (templates-and-patterns.md), plus the fields tasks/ja-vega-wp7 repairs add with a G-number: the T4 module chrome every wrapped section prints above itself (G19: section-title, main-section, bottom-desc, title-btn, link-btn, btn-type), `section-bg` (G22), `<field>-accent` and `intro-text` (G21), `layout` (G24), `video-url` (G25), and the two theme types `articles-category:slider|grid` that stand for the home page's mod_articles_category modules (G20). metadata.name is <type>.<field>[.<n>]; the wrapper of a repeated row is <type>.item.<n> and carries no role; a repeated field drawn outside the wrapper (the hero's copy, which only its first row fills) repeats on its own and the empty copies are removed. A block is located by name, never by position. Motion is markup: every block the source animates carries the motion library's opt-in classes (tracy-motion-reveal, --fade-left/--fade-right/--flip-up, tracy-motion-delay-N) and each carousel tracy-motion-carousel; a repeated row takes its delay from its place in a .jv-stagger group (assets/css/wp-ja-vega.css), since a cloned wrapper cannot carry its own delay class.

views.$comment: search is com_finder at /smart-search on the source; the theme answers that path with its search view (inc/extra.php wp_ja_vega_search_request), so the seeder adds no redirect for it. single is an article at its listing path on the source (/category-blog/<alias>); the theme answers a published page path followed by a post slug with that post (inc/extra.php wp_ja_vega_listing_post_request), so the route is probed for 200. The seeder still records a redirect rule for it (singleViewRules does not read servedAtPath); the rule is dormant, since the theme runs it only on a 404.
